$comment: Template for the Meta Quest Bubblewrap project. `npm run pack:quest -- --domain <host>`
renders this into twa-manifest.json (gitignored) with the host filled in, because the TWA
is bound to one origin and that origin differs per environment.
The values that are NOT free choices, and why:
horizonOSAppMode: immersive  - launch straight into the WebXR session. The Horizon Store
treats immersive and 2D as different product types.
display: fullscreen          - an immersive title must not present browser chrome.
packageId                    - permanent. Reusing it is how the store recognises an
update; changing it publishes a different app.
signingKey                   - the store binds the package to this key forever. Losing it
means never shipping an update to this listing again.
